bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GAYBBS_PREDEPLOY_READONLY\n'
printf 'pwd='; pwd
printf 'head='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'branch='; git branch --show-current
printf 'dirty_names_BEGIN\n'; git status --porcelain=v1 | cut -c 4- | head -60; printf 'dirty_names_END\n'
printf 'source_remote='; git config --get remote.origin.url | sed -E 's#(https?://)[^/@]+@#\1[REDACTED]@#g'
printf 'docker_name_image_status\n'; docker ps --filter name=deploy-gaybbs --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' || true
printf 'END_PREDEPLOY_READONLY\n'
